effects.label: ATK Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Regeneration
effects.description: Heals the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the buff. The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This buff can be stacked.

effects.label: RES Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Resistance stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

effects.label: Combo SPD Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Combo Speed stat by the indicated percentage.

bio: Ravizia was a Cambion, but she tried to use her healing powers to end the food crisis in the Evernight Baronies. The Barons couldn’t have that – she was imprisoned and turned Dusklit. Now a Nocturna Invoker, her healing powers turned dark… and her captors proved no match for her new strength.
